task: ae.lp exact simplex LP solver with self-checking certificates
reasoning_summary: Two-phase tableau simplex over exact BigInteger rationals with Bland's rule. Duals, Farkas vectors and unbounded rays are recovered from the final basis by solving B^T w = c_B, and an independent checker verifies every certificate using only the model. Tests cover textbook/Beale cases, parser errors with line numbers, kill checks on the checker, and 1500 random LPs compared with a vertex-enumeration oracle.
